context: The party has entered a long-abandoned chapel crypt that still gives off a faint, unmistakably divine presence. Shadowheart (a cleric) and a mystic both sense the lingering power but cannot identify which god the place once honored. There are clues that the site was more than a simple mausoleum—a hidden temple or shrine element is implied—but inscriptions, icons, or other identifying marks are missing or unfamiliar. Normally a cleric or paladin might recognize a patron from iconography, but here even trained worshippers are puzzled.
